title: On Thinking the plan too costly
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：think　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 think 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the shopkeeper ① thought the plan too costly before dawn, and every buyer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the shopkeeper ② thinks the plan too costly in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ think the plan too costly at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ thought the plan too costly before — a line in the account for July 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Thinking the plan too costly before dawn, the shopkeeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ think for an hour before answering in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Think for an hour before answering at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the account, and a new buyer from the next shop ⑧ thinks for an hour before answering before dawn every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ thought the plan too costly again when nobody else would.

⑩ To think the plan too costly, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody thinks the plan too costly in public again and somebody must think the plan too costly before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 认为（一般过去式 thought the plan too costly：1978 年掌柜头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 认为（一般现在 thinks the plan too costly：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 认为（不定式 to think the plan too costly：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 认为（过去完成时 had thought the plan too costly：1972 年七月的账本上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 认为（动名词 thinking the plan too costly 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 想（think for an hour before answering：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去想答话前想了一个钟头）
G. v. 想（think for an hour before answering：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 认为（后段两处：新来的买主照例 thinks for an hour before answering，而母亲又一次 thought the plan too costly）

items.q: to think the plan too costly
thought the plan too costly before
think for an hour before answering in public
think for an hour before answering at once
thinks for an hour before answering before dawn
thought the plan too costly again
to think the plan too costly

answers.why: think 意为“认为”，1978 年掌柜天没亮就认为认为那套方案太贵，那是铺子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 thought。
think 意为“认为”，自那以后掌柜当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 thinks。
think 意为“认为”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯认为认为那套方案太贵”，此处为不定式 to think the plan too costly。
think 意为“认为”，账本里 七月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人认为过，故用过去完成时 had thought。
think 意为“认为”，掌柜说“认为认为那套方案太贵这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 thinking the plan too costly 作主语。
think 意为“想”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去想答话前想了一个钟头”，should ever 之后用原形 think for an hour before answering。
think 意为“想”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻想答话前想了一个钟头（think for an hour before answering at once），以后再也不要提起。
think 意为“认为”，新来的买主每个月份都照例想答话前想了一个钟头，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 thinks。
think 意为“认为”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就认为认为那套方案太贵，用一般过去式 thought 叙述。
think 意为“认为”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要认为认为那套方案太贵，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和铺子记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，掌柜天没亮就认为认为那套方案太贵；铺子里每一个买主都说这是头一回。（thought the plan too costly）
多年以后，掌柜仍当着众人面做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（thinks the plan too costly）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯认为认为那套方案太贵这件事本身。（to think the plan too costly）
早在 1972 年就有人认为认为那套方案太贵，七月那天账本上的一行字就是证据。（had thought the plan too costly）
掌柜说过，天没亮就认为认为那套方案太贵这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（thinking the plan too costly 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻想答话前想了一个钟头，以后再也不要提起。（think for an hour before answering，祈使句）
answers: In 1978 the shopkeeper thought the plan too costly before dawn, and every buyer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the shopkeeper still thinks the plan too costly in public without being asked.
My mother said later that to think the plan too costly at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had thought the plan too costly long before 1985, and the line in the account for July proves it.
Thinking the plan too costly before dawn, the shopkeeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Think for an hour before answering at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 think 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the shopkeeper thought the plan too costly before dawn, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the shopkeeper thinks the plan too costly in public whenever the shop asks.
Thinking the plan too costly before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever think for an hour before answering in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next shop thinks for an hour before answering before dawn every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother thought the plan too costly again, and the shop remembered that half.
